name: s9_crest_hidden_vehicle
description: Scenario 9: crest of a hill hiding a stopped car. The road climbs at 8 % to a crest 150 m from the start (peak 6.9 m) and falls again; a car stands still in the ego lane 25 m beyond the crest (route distance 175 m). The approach is at 50 km/h. From the sensor height the car is hidden by the crest until the ego car is about 40 to 50 m away.
